## Mission

Evolve SWF toward a simpler, general, provider-neutral, decision-driven runtime for coding and office work, without building another orchestration stack beside the one that already exists.

North star: Trio owns truth. Code owns lifecycle. Decision Gates judge narrow semantics. ChiefOps owns governance. Linear exposes human attention. Night executes frozen slices. Morning reconciles evidence. Models provide capabilities, not identities.

* Trio = exactly `task_plan.md` / `findings.md` / `progress.md`, sole durable authority
* Quick/Tracked intake taxonomy (`deep-reasoning` normalizes to `tracked`)
* The 8-field assignment packet is the execution contract

* Provider-neutral model resolution through a declared `workRole`

## Retired — deliberately not reintroduced

* the three-route Decision-Plane Router (`lean-direct` / `tracked-lean` / `deep-rich`)
* per-unit execution contracts, JSON receipts, approval tokens

## Genuine gaps this initiative closes

1. No mode / intensity / topology vocabulary over the existing work roles, effort list and topology enums.

3. No infrastructure-vs-cognitive failure taxonomy.

> First night slice of the Decision-Control Runtime initiative. Additive only — no existing runtime behaviour may change.

## Task

Name the vocabulary SWF already implies. Add pure derivations over the existing enums so a requirement can be expressed as mode / intensity / topology without naming a model.

New frozen names: `MODE_KINDS = ['think','execute']`, `INTENSITY_LEVELS = ['low','medium','high','xhigh','max']`, `TOPOLOGY_CLASSES = ['solo','delegated','parallel']`, `modeOf(workRole)`, `intensitySubsetOf(mode)`, `normalizeIntensity(value, mode)`, `topologyClassOf(record)`.

## Local authority

**Local authority:** `planning/active/swf-decision-control-runtime-20260919/` three files; spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-design.md`; plan `docs/plans/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-plan.md`. Parent: <issue id="7dd163a7-d206-4421-8a02-e11853b146e0" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-35/decision-control-runtime-lifecycle-semantic-gates-and-provider-neutral">SUP-35</issue>.

## Execution intent

Mode: execute
Capability: dev
Intensity: high
Topology: solo
(These are semantic requirements, not model assignments. The Host resolves the implementation.)

## Scope

`harness/trio/core/routing.mjs` — **additive exports only**; a new or extended test file under `tests/trio/`; only if a new module is introduced, `tests/trio/import-boundaries.test.mjs` plus the `verify:trio` file list in `package.json`.

## Non-goals

Do **not** modify `classifyWorkRole`, `classifyComplexity`, `resolveModelEffort`, `validateModelEffort`, `topologyOf`, the assignment packet, or any existing exported behaviour. Do not widen `execute` intensity to `low|medium`. Do not add a second state machine. Do not edit files owned by the sibling `linear-multiproject-isolation-20260918` working tree.

## Done when

* Every new name is exported and unit-tested.
* `modeOf` is total over `CHIEF_WORK_ROLES` and `EXECUTION_WORK_ROLES` and throws on an unknown role.
* `normalizeIntensity('low','execute')` rejects; `normalizeIntensity('low','think')` accepts.
* `topologyClassOf` derives only from fields that already exist.
* No existing test expectation is edited; only new cases are added.

## Verification

`node --test` on the affected test file (targeted first), then `npm run verify:trio`, `npm run verify:core`, `./scripts/harness sync --check`. Record exact pass/fail counts.

## Dependencies

None.

## Night eligibility

**eligible** — tracked, bounded, additive, unattended-verifiable, no external or destructive step, edit surface disjoint from <issue id="39eac872-8da0-458e-8c8b-30cc1019853a" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-24/lmp-02-实现-v2-配置task-binding-与兼容读取">SUP-24</issue> / <issue id="35fac9fe-88b7-4748-9d9b-ad50f1ca7b8a" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-17/phase-1-契约层测量不变量契约-ux-design-接线">SUP-17</issue> / <issue id="c48e2a01-24ae-4172-803a-5be9f273ea79" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-15/dogfood-复核当前版本的-renderverify-工作流与晨间交接">SUP-15</issue>.

## Stop / replan conditions

Stop and record a blocker, or `REPLAN`, when: the recorded edit surface is not enough to finish; an existing test outside this ticket's list must change to make it pass; the plan's frozen names turn out to conflict with existing code; a human decision is needed; or the slice would need to touch another initiative's uncommitted files. Do not widen scope to work around any of these.

The slice was executed directly by the Chief in the phase-6 wave (`harness/trio/core/routing.mjs`, additive; `tests/trio/vocabulary.test.mjs`), so `agent-ready` and `nightly` were removed and the issue now sits at `In Progress` + `ready-review`. The queue holds exactly one slice from this initiative; this ticket is kept open for review, not re-queued.
